title: Feature tour
text: default, print_rtree() ends displayed directory/file count. Set count_footer = FALSE compact output.
code: print_rtree(demo, max_depth = 2) #> printtree-feature-tour/ #> |-- data/ #> |   `-- raw/ #> |-- empty/ #> |-- logs/ #> |   `-- debug.log #> |-- R/ #> |   `-- helpers.R #> |-- README.md #> `-- test_cache #>  #> 5 directories, 4 files print_rtree(demo, max_depth = 1, count_footer = FALSE) #> printtree-feature-tour/ #> |-- data/ #> |-- empty/ #> |-- logs/ #> |-- R/ #> |-- README.md #> `-- test_cache

title: Feature tour
text: ignore argument still supports exact basenames, ignore_type = "auto" also treats wildcard entries glob patterns. can opt regular expression matching control.
code: print_rtree(demo, ignore = c("*.log", "test_*"), max_depth = 2) #> printtree-feature-tour/ #> |-- data/ #> |   `-- raw/ #> |-- empty/ #> |-- logs/ #> |-- R/ #> |   `-- helpers.R #> `-- README.md #>  #> 5 directories, 2 files print_rtree(demo, ignore = "^(README|test_)", ignore_type = "regex", max_depth = 1) #> printtree-feature-tour/ #> |-- data/ #> |-- empty/ #> |-- logs/ #> `-- R/ #>  #> 4 directories, 0 files

title: Feature tour
text: Use prune = TRUE hide directories displayable children ignores depth limits applied.
code: print_rtree(demo, ignore = "*.log", prune = TRUE) #> printtree-feature-tour/ #> |-- data/ #> |   `-- raw/ #> |       `-- sales.csv #> |-- R/ #> |   `-- helpers.R #> |-- README.md #> `-- test_cache #>  #> 3 directories, 4 files

title: Feature tour
text: Use quiet = TRUE return_lines = TRUE want work tree programmatically.
code: lines <- print_rtree(demo, return_lines = TRUE, quiet = TRUE) head(lines, 4) #> [1] "printtree-feature-tour/" "|-- data/"               #> [3] "|   `-- raw/"            "|       `-- sales.csv"

title: Feature tour
text: write_tree() writes tree output text Markdown file. Parent directories created automatically default.
code: tree_md <- file.path(tempdir(), "printtree-feature-tour-output", "tree.md") write_tree(demo, tree_md, format = "md", title = "Feature Tour Tree") readLines(tree_md, n = 8) #> [1] "# Feature Tour Tree"     ""                        #> [3] "```"                     "printtree-feature-tour/" #> [5] "|-- data/"               "|   `-- raw/"            #> [7] "|       `-- sales.csv"   "|-- empty/"

title: Feature tour
text: tree_to_mermaid() tree_to_dot() convert tree diagram text renders Quarto documents: Mermaid flowcharts render natively {mermaid} chunks (GitHub), DOT graphs render {dot} chunks Graphviz installed. accept filtering options printed tree (ignore, max_depth, show_hidden, prune). write_tree() can write either diagram format directly, produce minimal Quarto document tree embedded Mermaid diagram:
code: cat(tree_to_mermaid(demo, max_depth = 2)) #> flowchart TD #>     n1(["printtree-feature-tour/"]) #>     n2(["raw/"]) #>     n3(["data/"]) #>     n4(["empty/"]) #>     n5["debug.log"] #>     n6(["logs/"]) #>     n7["helpers.R"] #>     n8(["R/"]) #>     n9["README.md"] #>     n10["test_cache"] #>     n3 --> n2 #>     n1 --> n3 #>     n1 --> n4 #>     n6 --> n5 #>     n1 --> n6 #>     n8 --> n7 #>     n1 --> n8 #>     n1 --> n9 #>     n1 --> n10 cat(tree_to_dot(demo, max_depth = 2)) #> digraph printtree { #>   rankdir=TB; #>   node [fontname="Helvetica"]; #>   "n1" [label="printtree-feature-tour/", shape=folder]; #>   "n2" [label="raw/", shape=folder]; #>   "n3" [label="data/", shape=folder]; #>   "n4" [label="empty/", shape=folder]; #>   "n5" [label="debug.log", shape=note]; #>   "n6" [label="logs/", shape=folder]; #>   "n7" [label="helpers.R", shape=note]; #>   "n8" [label="R/", shape=folder]; #>   "n9" [label="README.md", shape=note]; #>   "n10" [label="test_cache", shape=note]; #>   "n3" -> "n2"; #>   "n1" -> "n3"; #>   "n1" -> "n4"; #>   "n6" -> "n5"; #>   "n1" -> "n6"; #>   "n8" -> "n7"; #>   "n1" -> "n8"; #>   "n1" -> "n9"; #>   "n1" -> "n10"; #> } tree_qmd <- file.path(tempdir(), "printtree-feature-tour-output", "tree.qmd") write_tree(demo, tree_qmd, format = "qmd", title = "Feature Tour Tree",            max_depth = 2) readLines(tree_qmd, n = 12) #>  [1] "---"                                   #>  [2] "title: \"Feature Tour Tree\""          #>  [3] "---"                                   #>  [4] ""                                      #>  [5] "```{mermaid}"                          #>  [6] "flowchart TD"                          #>  [7] "    n1([\"printtree-feature-tour/\"])" #>  [8] "    n2([\"raw/\"])"                    #>  [9] "    n3([\"data/\"])"                   #> [10] "    n4([\"empty/\"])"                  #> [11] "    n5[\"debug.log\"]"                 #> [12] "    n6([\"logs/\"])"

title: Feature tour
text: diagram functions tricks. git_colors = TRUE tints nodes Git status (amber = modified, green = untracked, blue = staged), subgraph = TRUE wraps directory Mermaid subgraph container, repo_url makes every node clickable, linking file directory GitHub: tree_to_mindmap() renders tree radial Mermaid mindmap, tree_to_html() produces self-contained HTML page click--expand directories (external dependencies): Finally, tree_diff_mermaid() tree_diff_dot() compare two directory trees: nodes second tree green, nodes first red dashed. use output Quarto document, generate diagram paste {mermaid} chunk — let write_tree() produce whole Quarto document :
code: cat(tree_to_mermaid(demo, max_depth = 2, git_colors = TRUE, subgraph = TRUE,                     repo_url = "https://github.com/PrigasG/printtree")) #> flowchart TD #>     subgraph n1["printtree-feature-tour/"] #>         subgraph n3["data/"] #>             subgraph n2["raw/"] #>             end #>         end #>         subgraph n4["empty/"] #>         end #>         subgraph n6["logs/"] #>             n5["debug.log"] #>         end #>         subgraph n8["R/"] #>             n7["helpers.R"] #>         end #>         n9["README.md"] #>         n10["test_cache"] #>     end #>     click n1 "https://github.com/PrigasG/printtree/tree/main" #>     click n2 "https://github.com/PrigasG/printtree/tree/main/data/raw" #>     click n3 "https://github.com/PrigasG/printtree/tree/main/data" #>     click n4 "https://github.com/PrigasG/printtree/tree/main/empty" #>     click n5 "https://github.com/PrigasG/printtree/blob/main/logs/debug.log" #>     click n6 "https://github.com/PrigasG/printtree/tree/main/logs" #>     click n7 "https://github.com/PrigasG/printtree/blob/main/R/helpers.R" #>     click n8 "https://github.com/PrigasG/printtree/tree/main/R" #>     click n9 "https://github.com/PrigasG/printtree/blob/main/README.md" #>     click n10 "https://github.com/PrigasG/printtree/blob/main/test_cache" #>     n3 --> n2 #>     n1 --> n3 #>     n1 --> n4 #>     n6 --> n5 #>     n1 --> n6 #>     n8 --> n7 #>     n1 --> n8 #>     n1 --> n9 #>     n1 --> n10 cat(tree_to_mindmap(demo, max_depth = 2)) #> mindmap #>   root((printtree-feature-tour/)) #>     data/ #>       raw/ #>     empty/ #>     logs/ #>       debug.log #>     R/ #>       helpers.R #>     README.md #>     test_cache tree_html <- file.path(tempdir(), "printtree-feature-tour-output", "tree.html") write_tree(demo, tree_html, format = "html", title = "Feature Tour Tree",            max_depth = 2) cat(tree_diff_mermaid("project-v1", "project-v2")) # Generate once, then paste the output into a {mermaid} chunk # in your Quarto document: cat(tree_to_mermaid("myproject", max_depth = 2))  # Or write a ready-to-render Quarto document directly: write_tree("myproject", "tree.qmd", format = "qmd", title = "Project tree")

title: Printing directory trees with printtree
text: project = “root”, printtree can walk upward provided path detect project root using simple markers. default includes: .Rproj files (RStudio / Posit projects) DESCRIPTION files (R package roots) example, mark demo package-like root creating DESCRIPTION file, print subdirectory: can customize detection using rootmarkers:
code: file.create(file.path(demo, "DESCRIPTION")) #> [1] TRUE subdir <- file.path(demo, "data", "raw") print_rtree(subdir, project = "root") #> printtree-demo/ #> |-- data/ #> |   `-- raw/ #> |-- R/ #> |   `-- hello.R #> |-- DESCRIPTION #> `-- README.md #>  #> 3 directories, 3 files print_rtree(subdir, project = "root", root_markers = c(".Rproj", "DESCRIPTION", "_quarto.yml")) #> printtree-demo/ #> |-- data/ #> |   `-- raw/ #> |-- R/ #> |   `-- hello.R #> |-- DESCRIPTION #> `-- README.md #>  #> 3 directories, 3 files

title: printtree
text: printtree prints compact directory tree R projects folder. can optionally detect project roots associated common R workflows (e.g., RStudio projects via .Rproj files) print tree appropriate root directory. Trees can include count summaries, Git status annotations, pattern-based ignores, pruning empty directories, PNG snapshots, text Markdown exports. package IDE-agnostic: project metadata detected, simply prints directory tree specified folder.

title: printtree
code: # install.packages("printtree")

title: printtree
code: library(printtree)  # Current working directory print_rtree()  # Explicit path print_rtree("~/Projects/myproj")  # Project name (searched in search_paths) print_rtree("myproj", search_paths = c("~/Projects", "~/Documents"))  # Limit depth print_rtree(max_depth = 2)  # Ignore by glob pattern print_rtree(ignore = c("*.log", "test_*"))  # Annotate files with Git status print_rtree(git = TRUE)  # Return lines without printing lines <- print_rtree(return_lines = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)  # Use the old compact output without a count footer print_rtree(count_footer = FALSE)  # Hide directories with no displayable children print_rtree(ignore = "*.log", prune = TRUE)  # Unicode tree (if your terminal supports it) print_rtree(format = "unicode")  # Save a PNG snapshot print_rtree(snapshot = TRUE)  # Dark background snapshot print_rtree(snapshot = TRUE, snapshot_bg = "black", snapshot_file = "tree-dark.png")  #or White background with dark text print_rtree(snapshot = TRUE, snapshot_bg = "white", snapshot_file = "tree-white.png")  # Save to a specific directory print_rtree(snapshot = TRUE, snapshot_path = "~/Pictures")  # Save a Markdown tree write_tree(".", "tree.md", format = "md", title = "Project Tree")  # Mermaid flowchart (renders in Quarto {mermaid} chunks and GitHub Markdown) cat(tree_to_mermaid("."))  # Graphviz DOT graph cat(tree_to_dot("."))  # A ready-to-render Quarto document with the tree as a Mermaid diagram write_tree(".", "tree.qmd", format = "qmd", title = "Project Tree")  # Flowchart with Git-status colors, directory subgraphs, and clickable nodes cat(tree_to_mermaid(".", git_colors = TRUE, subgraph = TRUE,                     repo_url = "https://github.com/PrigasG/printtree"))  # Mermaid mindmap and a self-contained collapsible HTML tree cat(tree_to_mindmap(".", max_depth = 2)) write_tree(".", "tree.html", format = "html", title = "Project Tree")  # Diff two trees as a Mermaid flowchart (green = added, red dashed = removed) cat(tree_diff_mermaid("old-project", "new-project"))

title: Print an R Project or Directory Tree — print_rtree
text: Prints directory tree given path. Optionally, detects RStudio project (.Rproj) can print project root.

title: Print an R Project or Directory Tree — print_rtree
code: print_rtree(   path = NULL,   ignore = c("renv", ".git", ".Rproj.user", "__pycache__", ".DS_Store", "node_modules",     ".Rhistory"),   ignore_type = c("auto", "fixed", "glob", "regex"),   max_depth = NULL,   show_hidden = FALSE,   project = c("auto", "root", "none"),   search_paths = c(".", "..", "~/Documents", "~/Projects"),   root_markers = c(".Rproj", "DESCRIPTION"),   format = c("ascii", "unicode"),   return_lines = FALSE,   quiet = FALSE,   count_footer = TRUE,   git = FALSE,   git_legend = TRUE,   prune = FALSE,   snapshot = FALSE,   snapshot_file = "tree.png",   snapshot_width = 800,   snapshot_bg = c("white", "black"),   snapshot_path = "." )

title: Print an R Project or Directory Tree — print_rtree
text: path Character. Directory path, project name, .Rproj file. NULL, uses current directory. ignore Character vector. Basenames exclude (e.g., ".git", "renv"). ignore_type = "auto", entries containing wildcard characters treated glob patterns, values "*.log" "test_*" work. ignore_type One "auto", "fixed", "glob", "regex". Controls ignore matched basenames. max_depth Integer. Maximum depth traverse. NULL unlimited. show_hidden Logical (TRUE/FALSE). Whether include hidden files/directories (starting "."). project One "auto", "root", "none". "auto": alias "none"; use path -(upward search) "root": walk upward path find project root (via root_markers) use found "none": never attempt root detection; print tree path search_paths Character vector. Used path existing directory (treated project name). Paths searched order. root_markers Character vector. Markers used project = "root" detect root directory. Special value ".Rproj" means "file ending .Rproj". Common markers include "DESCRIPTION" (R package root) "_quarto.yml" (Quarto project root). format One "ascii" "unicode". "ascii" portable terminals. return_lines Logical. TRUE, invisibly return printed character vector lines. quiet Logical. TRUE, suppress console output. Useful return_lines = TRUE. count_footer Logical. TRUE, append summary like "3 directories, 12 files". git Logical. TRUE, annotate files directories porcelain git status markers path inside Git work tree. git_legend Logical. TRUE git = TRUE, append short legend explaining Git status markers. prune Logical. TRUE, omit directories displayable children. snapshot Logical. TRUE, gives visual snapshot tree. snapshot_file Text. Snapshot PNG name snapshot set TRUE. snapshot_width Integer 1 15000. Default 800. snapshot_bg Either white black snapshot background. white, tree text appears black vice. snapshot_path Character. snapshot_path provided, file saved .

code: old <- file.path(tempdir(), "printtree-diff-old") new <- file.path(tempdir(), "printtree-diff-new") for (d in c(old, new)) {   if (dir.exists(d)) unlink(d, recursive = TRUE)   dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE) } file.create(file.path(old, "gone.txt")) #> [1] TRUE file.create(file.path(new, "added.txt")) #> [1] TRUE  cat(tree_diff_dot(old, new)) #> digraph printtree { #>   rankdir=TB; #>   node [fontname="Helvetica"]; #>   "n1" [label="printtree-diff-new/", shape=folder]; #>   "n2" [label="added.txt", shape=note, style="filled", fillcolor="#dcfce7"]; #>   "n3" [label="gone.txt", shape=note, style="filled,dashed", fillcolor="#fee2e2"]; #>   "n1" -> "n2"; #>   "n1" -> "n3"; #> }  # Left-to-right layout cat(tree_diff_dot(old, new, rankdir = "LR")) #> digraph printtree { #>   rankdir=LR; #>   node [fontname="Helvetica"]; #>   "n1" [label="printtree-diff-new/", shape=folder]; #>   "n2" [label="added.txt", shape=note, style="filled", fillcolor="#dcfce7"]; #>   "n3" [label="gone.txt", shape=note, style="filled,dashed", fillcolor="#fee2e2"]; #>   "n1" -> "n2"; #>   "n1" -> "n3"; #> }

text: path Character. Directory path, project name, .Rproj file. NULL, uses current directory. file Character. Output file path. format One "txt", "md", "mermaid", "dot", "qmd", "mindmap", "html". "mermaid" writes Mermaid flowchart (renders Quarto {mermaid} chunks GitHub Markdown), "dot" writes Graphviz DOT graph, "qmd" writes minimal Quarto document embedding Mermaid flowchart, "mindmap" writes Mermaid mindmap, "html" writes self-contained collapsible HTML tree. title Optional heading: used Markdown heading format = "md", Quarto document title format = "qmd", page title heading format = "html". create_dirs Logical. TRUE, create output file's parent directory exist. ... Additional arguments passed underlying tree builder (tree options print_rtree(), ignore, max_depth, git, prune). Diagram engines also accept direction (Mermaid), rankdir (DOT), git_colors, subgraph, repo_url/repo_branch; see tree_to_mermaid() tree_to_dot().

title: printtree 0.3.0
text: New tree_to_mermaid() converts directory tree Mermaid flowchart, renders natively Quarto {mermaid} chunks, GitHub Markdown, anywhere else Mermaid supported. Directories use stadium shape, files use rectangles. New tree_to_dot() converts directory tree Graphviz DOT graph (folder/note shapes), renderable Quarto {dot} chunks DOT-compatible tool. write_tree() gains "mermaid", "dot", "qmd" formats: first two write raw diagram text, "qmd" writes minimal Quarto document embedding Mermaid flowchart. internal tree builder now also returns displayed nodes data frame (path, name, depth, directory flag, parent), diagram export sees exactly nodes printed tree, including prune ignore filtering. Diagram extras: tree_to_mermaid() tree_to_dot() gain git_colors (nodes tinted Git status: amber modified, green untracked, blue staged), repo_url/repo_branch (every node links file directory repository), tree_to_mermaid() gains subgraph (directory wrapped Mermaid subgraph container). New tree_to_mindmap() renders tree radial Mermaid mindmap, write_tree() gains "mindmap" format. New tree_to_html() (write_tree(format = "html")) writes self-contained collapsible HTML tree click--expand directories optional Git status badges; external dependencies. New tree_diff_mermaid() tree_diff_dot() render difference two directory trees: nodes second tree green, nodes first red dashed.

title: printtree 0.2.2
text: CRAN release: 2026-09-28 max_depth now validated: must NULL single non-negative whole number (previously invalid values behaved cryptically silently). snapshot_width must now single whole number 1 15000 (previously positive value passed, including fractions later failed inside graphics device). snapshot_path now checked tree built, ~ snapshot_file expanded; Windows UNC paths recognized absolute. Snapshot PNG height now capped large trees request enormous raster. Git directory labels now reflect nested status (? untracked, + staged, M modified, M taking precedence) instead always showing M. Git status now parsed git status --porcelain -z (NUL-separated, never quoted), file names spaces, Unicode characters, renames labeled correctly. Git repository paths now quoted invoking Git, status annotations work repository directory contains spaces (common Windows OneDrive-synced folders). Git path bytes now decoded explicit UTF-8 marking, Unicode file names keep status labels non-UTF-8 R sessions. Git integration tests now skip CRAN exit-status-checked repository setup, vignette Git example longer evaluated, Git repository initialized CRAN checks. Clarified project = "auto" alias "none", write_tree()’s ... goes underlying tree builder. Added multi-platform R CMD check workflow.

title: printtree 0.2.1
text: CRAN release: 2026-05-16 Fixed hidden file handling Windows directories hidden file-system attribute omitted show_hidden = FALSE, even names start “.”. Added count summaries displayed directories files. Added pattern-based ignores fixed, glob, regex, automatic matching modes. Added git = TRUE annotate displayed files directories simple Git status markers. Added quiet = TRUE programmatic use Git status legend git = TRUE. Added write_tree() text Markdown tree exports, automatic parent directory creation default. Added prune = TRUE hide directories displayable children.
